title: Meeting Bob Lazar and George Knapp at the start of the project

tellings.quote: I happened to meet Bob Lazar for the first time when we started this whole project >> and George Knapp and together.

plain: Peter Levenda, a writer presented on the show as a historian of the CIA, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that he met Bob Lazar for the first time at the start of a project in the late 2010s. Lazar is a man who says he once worked on alien craft for the government, and George Knapp, a journalist who has long reported his story, was there too. Levenda says the three of them came together as that project began.
